# Kosovo (XKX) - sub-national homicide

## Used
ASK PxWeb table vdekjet10.px "Vdekjet e dhunshme sipas komunave dhe llojit të vdekjes së dhunshme, 2010-2019": homicides (Vrasje), suicides, accidents and total violent deaths for each of 38 municipalities, "outside Kosovo" and the Kosovo total, 2010-2019. This is death-registration data, not police-recorded crime; the measure says so.

## Caveats
- 2018: municipalities + outside Kosovo sum to 20 homicides; the published total is 21. Other years add up exactly. Kept as published.
- Municipality names are as published in Albanian (e.g. "Mitrovicë", "Mitrovica Veriore", "Graçanicë").
- No later years: the newer mortality tables (death03 ... death26, 2020-2025) do not split by cause; "Shkaqet e Vdekjeve" tab16.px gives violent deaths 2018-2019 for Kosovo only.

## Not found / not reached
- ASK Justice tables (Jurisprudenca për Persona Madhorë law01-law12): accused/convicted persons by Basic Court, no offence type by area for homicide (titles checked; not extracted).
- Kosovo Police (kosovopolice.com): /raportet/ and /statistikat/ pages list no annual report PDFs; the WordPress media data service returned non-JSON. A police report with vrasje by regional directorate was not found. searching stopped early (search limit reached).
